name: 7 Dnej Leta: Lost Alpha
source:
The protagonist of «7 Days of Summer: Lost Alpha» is a young man leading a withdrawn lifestyle. Everything changes one night on New Year's Eve, when he decides to leave home and go out but instead finds himself in a camp already familiar to the reader.

At first glance, the story repeats itself: the bus, the camp, the girls... And yet, the minor differences gradually accumulate to grow into an entirely new story. A major role in this is played by our protagonist (or rather, protagonists): he differs from the usual Semyon, which is why his story is different.

Meanwhile, rumors are spreading throughout the camp that our protagonist is not quite an ordinary pioneer...

All of the main characters of Everlasting Summer (Lena, Miku, Alisa, Slavya, and Ulyana) have their own route, as well as Olga.

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=441054187]Steam Workshop[/url]]
translation:
《夏日七日：失去的阿尔法》的主角是一位过着孤僻生活方式的年轻人。除夕夜的一个晚上，一切都发生了变化，他决定离开家出去，却发现自己身处一个读者已经熟悉的营地。

乍一看，故事在重复：公共汽车、营地、女孩……然而，微小的差异逐渐积累，成长为一个全新的故事。其中一个主要角色是由我们的主角（或者更确切地说，主角）扮演的：他与通常的谢苗不同，这就是为什么他的故事不同。

与此同时，营地里传出谣言，说我们的主角不是一位普通的拓荒者……

《永恒之夏》的所有主角（莉娜、米库、艾丽莎、斯拉维亚和乌里安娜）都有自己的路线，奥尔加也是如此。

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=441054187]Steam创意工坊[/url]]
